name: xbrain-design
description: Design for your own products and the XBrain brain's designs (canvas, versions, build from a design, comments, HTML screens, sync, visual QA), from the product's value to code: the order of work, design types and their deliverables, reference research and style directions, a catalogue of named styles and patterns with a glossary of their parameters, words for designs, real product materials, marketing sites, design systems with Cyrillic type, motion through the studio, quality and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), and a starter set of design templates.
